one_line: A standards-CITATION benchmark for LLM financial auditing: real 10-K statements, injected errors, and deterministic FASB ASC citation ground truth cross-checked against the official US-GAAP taxonomy.
authors_note_to_supervisors: This bundle shows the dataset shape (identical to AuditBench, upgraded with real values + taxonomy-verified citations). Full generator + 1,089 records live in the repo; here are the schema, stats, three full sample records, and the novelty argument.

what_it_is.shape: Same as AuditBench: each record = one clean statement + one injected error + synthetic transactions + labels.
what_it_is.substrate: REAL 10-K balance sheets / income statements / cash flows from SEC EDGAR (values are actual reported facts, never fabricated).
what_it_is.transactions: SYNTHETIC (real filings never publish transaction-level ledgers) — they sum to the real line values.
what_it_is.ground_truth_citation: The governing FASB ASC code, chosen rule-first (before injection) and cross-checked against the official US-GAAP 2023 reference linkbase; tagged linkbase-verified vs expert-authored.
what_it_is.NOT_huge_tables: Compact single statements (~30 rows, [row n] text) like AuditBench — NOT FinMR's 17k-167k-char whole-filing dumps.

record_schema.metadata: {company, cik, fiscal_year, statement_type, period, unit, source}
record_schema.rule_id / error_type: which rulebook rule + AuditBench error type
record_schema.gt_transaction_data: synthetic transactions summing to real line values
record_schema.gt_xbrl_json: OIM-style fact list (concept, period, unit, value)
record_schema.ground_truth_citations: {asc_full, asc_subtopic, asc_topic, dqc_rule, linkbase_reference_set, linkbase_verified, citation_tier, rationale}

how_we_are_novel.gap: Detection is covered by prior work; standards CITATION attribution is not.
how_we_are_novel.vs_AuditBench: AuditBench (arXiv 2506.17282) has a citation field but it is GPT-4 free text scored ~26% by an unreleased retriever; synthetic companies. We give real data + deterministic, cross-checkable ASC citations.
how_we_are_novel.vs_FinAuditing: FinAuditing (arXiv 2510.08886) uses real XBRL + DQC but its tasks are concept-ID / relation-type / value-recompute — it never outputs an ASC citation.
how_we_are_novel.vs_FinMR: FinMR (FinAuditing subtask) outputs two numbers {extracted, calculated} over huge XBRL filings — no citation, and a long-context task, not ours.
how_we_are_novel.vs_AuditFlow: AuditFlow (arXiv 2606.03031) does deterministic taxonomy+XBRL verification but scores a numeric verdict, not citation attribution.
how_we_are_novel.our_contribution: The FIRST benchmark that scores 'name the governing ASC codification reference' on real filings with deterministic, cross-checkable ground truth — plus the measured finding that citation is a function of concept x violation, which the taxonomy linkbase alone under-determines (AR->310 not 210; revenue->606-50 disclosure not 606-25 recognition).
how_we_are_novel.recoverability_note_not_a_result: A citation-SELECTOR check (Stage-1 logic only, no detection/LLM): on AuditBench the correct citation is in the candidate set only 26.2% of the time (measured oracle); on IntelliAudit-Bench it is recoverable (concept-only heuristic ~51%; upper bound 100%). The 100% is TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION because injection is rule-first, so it is an upper bound, NOT the auditor's accuracy. Real results require a blind-LLM baseline + an actual staged-pipeline run (both TODO).

provenance.citations: official US-GAAP 2023 reference linkbase (sha256 b48fbb7b..., 17,800 concepts indexed)

metadata.source: SEC EDGAR companyfacts + filing calculation linkbase (real 10-K)

ground_truth_citations.rationale: Current assets are cash and other assets expected to be realized within one year / operating cycle; a current item placed under non-current assets misstates the current/non-current classification.
